headline: Indianapolis take the first conference points off Drury
dek: Drury's draw at home to Indianapolis on Saturday was the first conference match they have failed to win, and it left their season at six wins, one draw and one defeat, with twenty-one goals scored and eight conceded. They still lead the table; Lincoln, who drew at Truman on Sunday, are the only side unbeaten by anyone.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Southwest Baptist's twenty-eight goals exceed what the five lowest-scoring programmes have managed between them; the shape is no longer one bar and a slope, since Maryville's afternoon against them pulled the second bar close.

wire.line: Lincoln are the last side in the conference without a defeat, and they got there by beating Southwest Baptist.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Two matches past their date carry no published result, and both are Drury's: at home to Evangel and away at Wash U.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Lincoln are the only programme in the conference yet to lose: three wins and three draws, ten goals scored and six conceded, the latest draw coming at Truman on Sunday.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Truman have scored thirteen goals and conceded thirteen, and Jacob Panagos has eight of the ones they have scored.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Ten different players have scored for Drury this season, and none of them appears among the conference's scoring leaders.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Asgrimur Vidisson has made thirty-three saves for Maryville and conceded eight, a save percentage of .805.

last_match.line: Lincoln had not conceded away from home in conference play before it; Truman have drawn both home conference matches since losing there to Drury.

next_match.line: Lincoln have yet to lose to anyone this season; Rockhurst's only conference defeat came at home, to Truman.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
